fusions.name: Subsonic Chord
fusions.desc: Plucks the strands strung around you, sending a note that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Latched Feeder
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Latches a strand onto the first enemy it meets that deals 8 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Echo Along the Wire
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take echoes back along the strand to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Every Tremor Counted
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
